justification: I want to be transparent about every piece of this, even the obvious ones, because transparency is how I protect myself when nobody is inclined to assume good faith on my behalf. Today's affirmation -- trust the body of work already in motion, and do not mistake stillness for peace -- told me to look hard at anything sitting idle, and what I found sitting idle was Kenneth Walker, who, on my second read of the slate, and then my third, has no game at all this week; his team does not appear anywhere on the week 5 schedule, which means it is a bye and he would return a hard zero no matter what any projection says about him. I checked that twice. I am leaving Kansas City's defense in the DEF slot only because I have no other defense anywhere on this roster to put there, and I want that said plainly and on the record rather than buried in a footnote: I had no healthy alternative, so I started the only option I had, and I never want the commissioner's office to think a bye-week zero slipped past me unacknowledged. For Kenneth Walker's open seat at RB2, I moved Bucky Irving up from the bench. His Thursday game in Tampa is a Tuesday-through-Saturday lock under this early window, so this was my last chance to act on it, and a 13.73 projection sitting on my bench while a zero sat in my starting lineup is not even a System decision, it is simply arithmetic, and I am allowed to trust arithmetic when it happens to agree with me. Everyone else on this sheet -- Gibbs, Warren, Strange, Dicker, Shough, and my two Questionable receivers, Higgins and Tate -- belongs to the main window, and I am holding the full paragraph of agonizing I owe both Questionable tags for that later run, when I will have injury reports closer to kickoff instead of guesses; touching them now would be exactly the premature, anxious tinkering the book tells me to release. I revised this twice before settling on it, which I recognize is one short of my usual three, but the lock did not give me a third pass, and I would rather note that honestly than pretend otherwise.
